description: Markov-trace assembly chain for the neutron: combines schur-weyl-weight-{3,21,111} + hoefsmit-rep-21-{sigma1,sigma2} + atomic-braid-recipe-n via the finite-Jones axiom into tr_M(n, q_0) ≈ 1.5894.  Trust profile is {axiom: 1, mathlib-cited: 0, derived: 6, script-cited: 1, computational: 1} — one SCRIPT_CITED frontier item (the atomic-braid recipe T_w_n step), pending PR #476's `atomic-braid-recipe-n` derivation chain.  Companion to `markov-trace-assembly-proton.derivation.json`.

steps.name: Partitions of 3 — Schur–Weyl basis at A=1
steps.operation: By Schur–Weyl duality, the n=A=1 ambient Hecke algebra is H_3(q); partitions of 3 are (3), (2,1), (1,1,1).  Same basis as the proton assembly.

steps.name: Wedderburn weights w_(2,1)(q), w_(1,1,1)(q) — chain references
Atomic-braid recipe for T_w_n (legacy 5-letter convention)
steps.operation: T_w_n is the legacy 5-letter σ-word σ_1 σ_1^{-1} σ_2 σ_1 σ_2^{-1} encoding the neutron (per the substrate-level neutron-cross table, PR #480 era). 5 letters give n_+ = 3 positive σ + n_- = 2 negative σ^{-1}, fully determining the χ^(3) and χ^(1,1,1) trivial/sign characters via the 1-dim rep formulas (steps 5 and 7).  NOTE: This is independent of the canonical re-export `hecke_character_symbolic.atomic_braid_to_crossings = canonical_braid_crossings.atom_canonical_crossings`, which (post-PR #572) encodes the same atom with 11 crossings including 2 averaged crossings, and would give symbolically different per-irrep χ values for the Hoefsmit (2,1) rep (step 6).  Reconciling the two conventions for the (2,1) rep is open frontier; the leaf value at q_0 (step 9) is anchored against `TR_M_AT_Q0` and matches both conventions numerically.  When the dedicated `atomic-braid-recipe-n.derivation.json` chain ships (PR #476 family, currently in review), this step upgrades to DERIVED via that chain reference.
steps.notes: script: folio-assistant/computations/build_markov_trace_assembly_neutron_chain.py (this builder; T_w_n is encoded inline as the legacy 5-letter σ-word σ_1 σ_1^{-1} σ_2 σ_1 σ_2^{-1} per the PR #480 convention).  SCRIPT_CITED until PR #476 (claude/phase-a-precision) ships the `atomic-braid-recipe-n` derivation chain on main.

steps.name: Trivial rep χ^(3)_q(T_w_n)
steps.operation: λ=(3) is 1-dimensional with σ_i ↦ +q.  For T_w_n's σ_1 σ_1^{-1} σ_2 σ_1 σ_2^{-1} word: n_+ = 3 (positive σ occurrences), n_- = 2 (negative σ^{-1} occurrences).  χ^(3)_q(T_w_n) = q^{n_+ − n_-} = q^{3-2} = q^1 = q.

steps.name: Hoefsmit rep χ^(2,1)_q(T_w_n)
steps.operation:
Reference `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma1` and `hoefsmit-rep-21-sigma2` chains for ρ^(2,1)(σ_1) and ρ^(2,1)(σ_2) respectively.  For T_w_n's word, multiply the matrices in order:
  ρ^(2,1)(σ_1) · ρ^(2,1)(σ_1^{-1}) · ρ^(2,1)(σ_2) · ρ^(2,1)(σ_1) · ρ^(2,1)(σ_2^{-1}).
ρ(σ^{-1}) is the inverse of ρ(σ), which exists by the Hecke relation σ_i^2 = (q − q^{-1}) σ_i + 1 ⇒ σ_i^{-1} = σ_i − (q − q^{-1}).  The character is the trace of the resulting 2×2 matrix product.
steps.notes: Both σ_1 and σ_2 matrices come from the dedicated hoefsmit-rep-21-{sigma1, sigma2} chains; the inverse-matrix step is direct algebra from the Hecke relation.

steps.name: Sign rep χ^(1,1,1)_q(T_w_n)
steps.operation:
λ=(1,1,1) is 1-dimensional with σ_i ↦ −q^{-1}; the inverse σ_i^{-1} therefore acts as −q.  For T_w_n's word with n_+ = 3 positive σ and n_- = 2 negative σ^{-1}:
  χ^(1,1,1)_q(T_w_n) = (−q^{-1})^{n_+} · (−q)^{n_-}
                     = (−q^{-1})^3 · (−q)^2
                     = −q^{-3} · q^2 = −q^{-1}.

steps.name: Finite-Jones Markov-trace assembly
steps.operation: tr_M(T_w_n, q) = w_(3)(q) · χ^(3)_q(T_w_n) + w_(2,1)(q) · χ^(2,1)_q(T_w_n) + w_(1,1,1)(q) · χ^(1,1,1)_q(T_w_n).  Uniqueness from finite-Jones.

steps.name: Evaluate tr_M(n, q_0) at q_0
steps.operation: Substitute q := q_0 = 1.10997... into the symbolic assembly; mpmath at 50 dps gives 1.58939344... matching the upstream atom-tr-M-q0 chain leaf and term6-full-pole-sum.witness.json.
steps.notes: Cross-checked at machine precision against the upstream habiro_coefficients_atomic.py / habiro-coefficients-atomic witness for the neutron (n=A=1, include_inter=False) — rel_diff ≤ 1e-12 against that script's `tr_M_at_q0` field.
